text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the modern workplace. One of the most visible changes is automation, where software handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. In addition, AI-powered productivity tools can analyze large datasets, summarize reports, and even draft emails, saving precious time. However, AI is not replacing humans entirely; instead, the future lies in human-AI collaboration. Workers who learn to use these tools effectively will become more valuable. While some jobs will change or disappear, new roles will emerge, requiring a mix of technical skills and emotional intelligence. The key is to adapt and embrace lifelong learning.
